storyInfo: Ursus is thrown into turmoil as its mines dry up. Anatoliy, son of the First Army's Marshal, has contracted Oripathy, and is murdering innocents out of despair, until the Marshal brings him someone who appears to be able to cure the pain of Oripathy: Hierda. She 'heals' Anatoliy.

attributes.content: <p=1>Adeptus Sprawiedliwi Kazimierz Headquarters</> <p=2>Nov 1101</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: I understand the situation.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: My concern is, will this information also cross the desk of the General Chamber of Commerce as we are speaking?
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: I expect so. Something on this scale cannot be covered up completely. The G.C.C. will find out.
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: Intel from multiple sources indicates a high likelihood that something abnormal is happening to the Kolossal Prime Vein, and that Ursus is facing an energy crisis.
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: This is corroborated by the recent movements of the First Army on the border... it's certainly cause for concern.
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: We do not know if the energy issues will spread to other regions, nor how Ursus may react.
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: Has there been any official communication from Grypherburg?
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: In the face of such a crisis, the empire's first reaction is to hide the truth, rather than seek cooperation. Their stance is clear as day.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: A dying beast is a dangerous one. Even without its energy advantage, the Ursine war machine remains terrifying.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: We have defeated many foes. We are not afraid of war. But we must be even more vigilant about threats from within.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: You are concerned that the G.C.C. will use this as leverage against the Adeptus?
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: Even they must know the threat we will face if Ursus chooses to expand at this time. Kazimierz cannot afford another incident!
attributes.name: Adeptus Messenger

attributes.content: Do not underestimate the merchants' thirst for profit.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: They're already making their move. The invisible war already began when they framed their first innocent campaign knight.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: Fetch me Liam. Quickly.
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: And where is the scion of Nearl these days?
attributes.name: Russell

attributes.content: <p=1>Eastern Mines, Fifth Army Territory</> <p=2>Dec 1101</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Enough! Stop blowing it up! Do you want the whole mountain to collapse?!
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Don't you understand, mudak? There's nothing here! Not even one chunk of Originium! It's all dried up! Gone!
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Shut your trap! We must keep digging! This isn't the Far North... the ore in the east isn't gone! We just need to get it out first—
attributes.name: Despairing Officer

attributes.content: 'Find the Originium'! Those are our orders!
attributes.name: Despairing Officer

attributes.content: Well, you can hang us all then, because those orders aren't happening!
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Ivan's gone blind and I'm deaf in one ear! Better to hang than have all my organs turned to mush by the bombs!
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Turn us Infected and bury us in the mountains for all I care! Maybe you'll get the Originium growing again that way!
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: Gosudar-batyushka... have mercy on us... have mercy on Ursus...
attributes.name: Crumbling Soldier

attributes.content: <p=1>Second Army Frontline Territory</> <p=2>Jan 1102</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: ...That concludes my report.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Intercepted communications indicate that the Third Army has received news and announced a ceasefire with the Seventh. Only mobile units remain on standby.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Where was the explosion?
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: In the wilderness of Central, roughly 2300 km in a straight line from our front lines with the Fourth Army, with no nomadic cities making their winter transit nearby.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: But the scattered settlements in the area were not evacuated in advance. Rumors are that the people and animals were annihilated instantly, leaving behind only strange-colored soil and ash... it must have been incredibly powerful.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Has the First Army really developed such a terrible weapon?
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Stand by for further instructions from Command.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: The Marshal will make the right decision. Until then, as soldiers of the 6th Artillery Regiment of the Second Army's 2nd Division...
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: We will continue to stand against the traitors outside Grypherburg.
attributes.name: Officer

attributes.content: <p=1>Upper Deck, Flagship of the Fourth Army's main fleet</> <p=2>12 Jan 1102</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: ...Here ends the Grand Duchess's message.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: The last batch of supplies has been delivered, and what information we have on the First Army's new weapon is included in the letter.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: Her Imperial Highness wishes to communicate that this is the full extent of the help that the Far North can provide to the Fourth Army.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: We have fulfilled our end of the bargain. We pray that you do not forget yours, even in the current stalemate with the Second Army.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: I understand. But I hope Her Imperial Highness sees the present situation clearly.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: The conservatives maintain an iron grip over the Council. Backed by the First Army's research, they deny our legitimate claims, our desire to make Ursus great again.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: Time is precious. We will be handing over the nation if the Fourth Army does not achieve the expected aim, and Bresk will hardly be immune if that happens.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: It is not my place to respond on behalf of Her Imperial Highness, but I shall deliver your message faithfully to her.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: Perhaps I could also tell you an old fable, on her behalf.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: The north wind and the sun made a wager on who could get a passing traveler to remove his cloak—
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: Escort the honorable herald out.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: Make sure she leaves the base and delivers my message to Bresk safely.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: I'm afraid I have another important matter to attend to on this trip, and will not be returning to Bresk immediately.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: I wish you the best of luck. For the glory of Ursus.
attributes.name: Messenger

attributes.content: For the glory of Ursus.
attributes.name: Sullen Soldier

attributes.content: Get lost...
attributes.name: Hoarse Voice

attributes.content: Get lost!
attributes.name: Hoarse Voice

attributes.content: <p=1>First Army Territory</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Hah... you brought this on yourself.
attributes.name: Hoarse Youth

attributes.content: You can blame your own insolence.
attributes.name: Hoarse Youth

attributes.content: The young man kicks away the body of the soldier whose throat he just cut, and walks toward the depths of the command center.
The path leading from the deck is littered with bloody bodies, some of which are still twitching. None of the onlookers dare come any closer.
Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: Footsteps. The crowd quickly disperses.
Against the crowd, a pair of boots steps through puddles of blood, stopping only at the sound of metal clanging against blade.
The soldier gazes down at the young man.
Are you done fooling around?
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: Then put your sword down.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: As I've told you before, while you're free to punish those who anger you, showing your rage is simply showing your weakness.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: It is disgraceful, Anatoliy.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: But you've imprisoned me here. While I'm in pain and life has lost all meaning, you just keep me locked up here!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You would not even allow me to witness the birth of Kushkina.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: It's for your own safety.
attributes.name: Dignified Soldier

attributes.content: Safety? Hah, safety!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I'm in the heart of the First Army's territory under your great leadership, Marshal Buterina! Is there any place in Terra that is safer?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Yet you would not allow me to step out, not even onto the deck...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Have I become your prisoner just because I have Oripathy? Am I no longer your son, no longer a glorious soldier of Ursus?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Nothing has changed, Anatoliy. I treat you as I always have.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Then let me go! I want to go to Zelgrad. I want to patrol and watch over my city as I always have—as you promised!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Silent again. You're going back on your word, aren't you?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Get someone to clean up, Yasha. As usual.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Yes, madam.
attributes.name: Diligent Servant

attributes.content: Mother!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Yes, synochek, I promised you that Zelgrad will be yours. But not yet.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You must not leave my sight until your condition is stable. Do you understand?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: No, I don't!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: If you won't let me go, I'll keep killing with this sword that you gave me until there's no one left to guard me. These kozyols wouldn't dare raise a finger against me anyway—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I said, until your condition is stable. Once it is, you can go and do whatever you want to do.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You're playing word games now. Have those handsome Grypherburg bureaucrats changed how you feel about words?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I should have killed them all.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I captured that Cautus who claims to heal Oripathy.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Her companions were all Infected, as the rumors say. They feel no pain and show no symptoms.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I think it is worth seeing her, even if she's a fraud.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You would show my pain and weakness to a fraud?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Of course not.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The soldier touches the blade at her chest with her finger. Trembling, the young man finally lowers his sword.
Then, the mother pulls her son into a tight embrace.
If she is truly a fraud, then neither she nor her companions will leave here alive. But if she can truly stabilize your condition, even heal it...
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Then I shall embrace her, as I embrace you now.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: A lowly Cautus who came from nothing will become a member of the glorious First Army. Because she helped you.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Mama...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Wipe your tears, synochek. Our guest will be here soon.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Bring her, Yasha.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The blood and gore is quickly cleaned up, and the floor once again sparkles as new.
Heavy, orderly footsteps approach, but there is discordance in the order. A lighter footstep, decidedly out of place, causes everyone to look up.
Its source soon reveals itself.
What—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Neither a middle-aged man raggedly dressed in self-styled piety, nor a well-dressed charlatan.
Just a girl with a delicate frame and eyes wide open, herded along the dark carpet like a burdenbeast.
Uh...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: She's the one?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: What could she possibly do? A stiff breeze could blow her over. She wouldn't even make good firewood.
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Do not be deceived by appearances. She is indeed the leader of those vagrants.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: My personal guard found her surrounded by adoring vagrants, as at the Grypherburg trial over two years ago.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: It made our removal of her from the crowd seem shameless and preposterous, just like that trial.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: You would compare her to the Yurodstvo?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Enough of that. As long as she can help you, I do not care what she is, whether she's a peasant or the Yurodstvo.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Come forward.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The girl shakes her head hesitatingly without moving her feet.
Uh...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Are my companions being taken care of?
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: I want to make sure of that.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: You certainly have nerve.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I only hope to protect my companions.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: You must recognize that you are in no position to bargain.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: This is your last chance. Come forward.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The Cautus seems to recognize the situation and comes forward as instructed, but Anatoliy begins backing off hastily.
Anatoliy?
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: She's Infected! Why doesn't she heal herself, if she can heal the Infected?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: She's a fraud, Mother. I don't want to waste time on such fruitless endeavors. I don't have time—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Take it back.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: Mother?
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Take it back! You must not say such things. You have time. You'll get better. You must.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The tall woman turns to the girl and peers into her eyes.
You will heal my son, as you have healed those vagrants.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: If you can heal him...
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I, Svetlana Ulyanova Buterina, Marshal of the First Army, vow that the First Army shall protect you and your companions for the rest of my days.
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: I have to assess his condition, but my presence seems to bring him discomfort?
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: How can I heal him if I can't even touch him?
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: As if a little distance would be a problem if you really had the power to heal Oripathy!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The young man turns his head, as though trying to hide the Originium crystals on his cheeks in his hair, refusing to even look at the girl, much less approach her.
The Cautus girl seems to make up her mind. She takes one look at the commander who forcibly 'invited' her here, then approaches the young man.
I take you at your word, madam...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Stay away from me, peasant!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: If you take one more step towards me—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.text: <color=#d41f1f>Then you will become what you hate the most.</color>
You trampled upon what little dignity we had left, Generalik, just because you have a marshal for a mother, never tasting the mud and blood of true battle...
<color=#d41f1f>You should have paid for your arrogance long ago!</color>

attributes.content: Get away! Get away from me!!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Anatoliy, put down the sword—
attributes.name: Svetlana

attributes.content: The Cautus does not stop. The blade grazes her neck, leaving a small wound.
The young man stumbles backward, covering his face with his hand, as though he is the one wounded.
A sudden, violent flare-up of Oripathy, or just painful memories awakened by the sight before him?
I'm not—I didn't—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: ...Please, calm down...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: It'll be over soon.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: The young man has no room to back off further. When he is about to fall, the girl reaches out and takes the taller youth in her arms.
Both of them fall to the ground. The young man's trembling hands let go of his sword; no more angry words come from his pale lips.
The pain has overcome him.
Argh—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Your condition is serious...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: And you're starting to hyperventilate.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: Follow the rhythm of my breathing, and let my words help you rediscover the feeling of full lungs.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: The Cautus touches his cold, tense fingers and sees the black crystals emerging from flesh, hard and sharp as their host.
She puts her hand on the young man's forehead, her voice soft and gentle as she guides his breathing.
*exhale*
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: 'Believe. Believe in our life.'
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: 'Believe in our body and mind, believe in every beat of our heart, believe in every inhale and exhale.'
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: 'Believe that we...'
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: '...are the source of all strength.'
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: *cough* *cough*!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: You are just someone in pain.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: I... I don't need your pity—
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: I don't need the pity of an Infected, of all people...!
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: This is not pity, only sorrow.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: For I cannot cure your Oripathy.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: ...Fraud...
attributes.name: Anatoliy

attributes.content: The only thing I can do...
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Is soothe your pain in this life.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: As the black Originium on the surface of the young man's body fades and changes, the menacing expression on his face softens.
His eyes remain closed, but his heaving chest has calmed.
Hence, we pass over to the other side.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: Where there is no pain, no sorrow.
attributes.name: Cautus

attributes.content: The land of eternity.
attributes.name: Cautus
